name: wmNavigationVariable
description: Navigation Action provides navigation capabilities to help in navigating from one page or view to another.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: This method invokes the navigation action

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: the key-value pair of data to be passed via the variable to the other page in the form of URL params

methods.name: setData
methods.description: This method sets the input fields on the Navigation Action.

parameters.name: paramName
parameters.description: name of the target page parameter

parameters.name: paramValue
parameters.description: value for the target page parameter

examples: Var nv = Page.Actions.goToPage_TestPage; nv.setData({'param1': "param value","param2": "param value 2"}); nv.invoke();

name: wmNotificationVariable
description: Notification Action is an action to show UI notifications in the app in the form of a toaster, alert or a confirmation box. It provides message capabilities, a way for the app to notify the end users. Based on the operation selected app can notify the user through an Alert/Confirm dialog or a simple toaster message. This action can be useful in cases like error handling, confirm user action, etc.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: This method invokes the notification action

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: text to be displayed in the toaster.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: where to display the toaster. Possible values: 'top left', 'top center', 'top right', 'center left', 'center center', 'center right', 'bottom left', 'bottom center', 'bottom right'

examples: // Example 1: Notify with default set properties Page.Actions.goToPage_TestPage.invoke();
// Example 2: Notify with dynamic properties Page.Actions.notificationAction1.invoke({ "class": "info", "message": "My custom message",    "position": "bottom right" });
// Example 3: Passing data through alert type notification actionPage.Actions.notificationAction1.invoke({ "data": {“mode”: “edit}});

methods.name: setData
methods.description: This method sets the input fields on the Navigation Action.

parameters.name: paramName
parameters.description: name of the target page parameter

parameters.name: paramValue
parameters.description: value for the target page parameter
